why: arms a platform timer that refills a Sporadic scheduling context's budget at the end of each period. Scheduling contexts and budget servers are a nano-ros extension with no rclrs counterpart: rclrs runs on a host OS and has no budgeted callbacks to refill. The sibling of `rust:Executor::register_sporadic_timer`, which takes the timer before the budget state exists; this one creates the state first, because the timer's callback argument must point at it.
